fork.cow.create.f1000.p50.why: Copy-on-write fork latency at 1000 forks (BENCH-FORK-1). Dominated by opening a SQLite connection and cloning caches; sub-millisecond values swing with scheduler noise on 4 vCPUs.

fork.cow.read.fork.f20.p50.why: Point reads through a fork (BENCH-FORK-1); CPU-bound in memory at about 10 us, so scheduler noise is a large share.

fork.cow.storage_vs_full.f1000.why: Storage of 1000 forks against 1000 full copies. Page counts are deterministic for a fixed workload, so only a real layout change moves it.

sim.dst.serial_total_s.why: The D79 simulator set (sim.dst.serial_total_s), run serially on a Boat default VM. #1223 saw 33.4 s and 34.7 s for the same set on two VMs (about 4%); 15% leaves room for VM-to-VM CPU variance on a single run.
